description: Labelled questions for evaluating tool retrieval and tool selection in the Bamboo planner. Each case names the tool(s) a correct plan must propose. Cases flagged 'hard' pair a question with a tool it is deliberately easy to confuse for another catalogue tool; those are reported separately, because aggregate recall hides exactly the failures retrieval is most likely to cause.

provenance.authored: Written for this corpus, from tool descriptions and routing guidance, to cover tools the cheat sheet has no section for and confusions it does not probe.

coverage_exempt.bamboo_llm_probe: Startup credential check; invoked by the interface, never asked for in words.
coverage_exempt.bamboo_last_evidence: Reads the previous call's evidence; an interface affordance, not a question.
coverage_exempt.bamboo_promptlog_status: Drains buffered write events for the system panel.
coverage_exempt.bamboo_promptlog_rate: Invoked by the rating control with an index and document id.
coverage_exempt.atlas.ui_manifest: Returns UI branding metadata at startup.
